_comment: Operational approval record for the Shopify release gate (scripts/operators/shopify_release_gate.py). Shipped UNFILLED and fail-closed: the gate refuses every phase until the owner fills it in a dedicated approval-only change, binds it to the runtime inventory digest printed by `python scripts/operators/shopify_release_gate_render.py inventory`, and the pre-deploy command is re-rendered. `deployment_rollback_snapshot` is the deployment that would be redeployed to withdraw the release; it is not database recovery. `db_recovery_evidence.backup` is an observed completed backup card (not proof of recovery); `restore_verified` becomes true only after an independently verified restore rehearsal and is required for every schema-changing phase (S1, S2, S3). Timestamps are UTC `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`.
